items.name: VoltaGrid microgrid power-generation partnership extension
items.claim: ABB's Motion and Automation business areas extended their partnership with VoltaGrid, a US-based microgrid power generation company, with Motion supplying synchronous condensers with flywheel technology and Automation supplying prefabricated eHouse units, enabling the voltage stability required by next-generation AI chips.
items.source_excerpt: extended the partnership with VoltaGrid, a US-based microgrid power generation company. Under this agreement, Motion will supply their industry-leading synchronous condensers with flywheel technology that act like shock absorbers for the grid to keep electricity stable. These go alongside associated prefabricated eHouse units delivered by Automation, including their leading electrical distribution panels for low voltage and medium voltage distribution, variable frequency converters and PLC's for power control.

items.name: Medium-voltage manufacturing capacity expansion, Europe
items.claim: ABB will invest approximately $200 million in its medium-voltage manufacturing capabilities across Europe over the next three years to expand production capacity and accelerate the transition to next-generation power-distribution technologies.
items.source_excerpt: we will invest approximately $200 million in our medium-voltage manufacturing capabilities across Europe over the next three years.
